name: recent-funding-rounds
description: One bounded, read-only Brave News Search for recently published startup-funding coverage. Requires an explicit funding-news focus and rolling publication-freshness window; returns news evidence rather than verified structured deal records.

focus.description: Concrete funding-news focus, such as 'artificial intelligence startups', 'fintech Series A', or 'startup rounds over $10M'.

freshness.description: Rolling publication window supported by Brave News Search: 'pd' (24 hours), 'pw' (7 days), 'pm' (31 days), or 'py' (365 days).

steps.label: bounded recent funding-news search — Brave Search (MPP on Tempo)
